answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Work waits on the onyx until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the vertex of the next round. What survives to the copper is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, expired if not renewed by fresh work, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
